name: Shape Series
blurb: A row of shapes changes step by step. What comes next?
childIntro: Look along the row. Something changes a little bit each time. What should the next one look like?
howItWorks: A row of boxed figures shows a step by step change, and the child picks what comes next. It appears at every OLSAT level from kindergarten to grade 12. At the upper levels two things change at once, often moving in opposite directions.
parentTip: The skill is describing the step in words. Ask what changed between box one and box two, then check the same change happened between two and three. If it did not, the step is not constant and something else is going on.

questions.prompt: What comes next?

figure.alt: One circle, then two, then three, then an empty box.

questions.explanation: One, two, three. One more each time. So four comes next.
questions.strategy: Count each box out loud as you go along the row.

questions.prompt: What comes next?

figure.alt: A row of shapes that change step by step, then an empty box.

questions.explanation: Look along the row: the shape gets a little bigger each step. Carry that on one more step and you get a big pink lightning bolt. Choice b stopped one step early.
questions.strategy: Work out what changes between the first two boxes, then check the same change happens again to the third.
